name: spoils-idos-shell
description: SPOILS iDos Games edition client: the game's lobby and PixiJS client from apps/web, built as the static bundle iDos hosts at https://<titleid>.idos.games, signed in with @idosgames/core and talking to our API and game server. Not part of the pnpm workspace on purpose: build it with npm here after a root pnpm install (docs/IDOS_EDITION.md).
